biggest_catch: It's $30 — and only if you sign up through the promotional landing page, fund your first Cash Account with $500 within 30 days of opening, and still have $500+ sitting there on day 30. Open the account from Wealthfront's homepage any other way and you get $0. The bigger 'up to $500 match' headlines you may see are a separate invited/affiliate investing offer (0.50% match for 3 months on up to $100,000 deposited), not this $30.
catches: You must sign up through the promotional landing page — 'solely available to individuals who do not have an existing Investment Account or Cash Account and who sign up through the promotional landing page.'
Open and fund your FIRST Cash Account at Wealthfront Brokerage with at least $500 within 30 days of account opening, and maintain a balance of at least $500 on the 30th day following account opening.
Must pass Wealthfront's identity verification process.
No existing Investment Account or Cash Account — first-time clients only for this promotion.
The $30 is deposited within 30 days after meeting the terms — the full path to cash takes up to ~60 days.
Wealthfront reserves the right to change the terms or terminate the promotion at any time without notice, and to decline or reclaim the promotion for suspected violations or fraud.

The 0.50% investing deposit match (3 months, up to $100,000 deposited = up to $500) seen on invited/affiliate pages is a separate, referral-flavored offer — not part of this $30 promotion. APY boosts (e.g. 0.65% new-client boost for 3 months on up to $150K) are rate bumps, not cash.
